## Problem, scope and intended change

Which swimming knowledge file(s) or claims changed, and for whom is the change applicable?

## Evidence and uncertainty

Cite inspected sources and their limitations. Distinguish individual observations, author inference and externally established claims.

## Safety, transfer and privacy

State prerequisites, stop conditions, competing explanations, and how whole-stroke transfer would be evaluated. No private session information or copyrighted source files.

## Checks

- [ ] Followed [KPS Core AUTHORING.md](https://github.com/xiongxianfei/knowledge-practice-system/blob/8fd410d1a8dec8b3e38352c9166639906049ec55/AUTHORING.md)
- [ ] Reviewed water safety, pain, and air-access risks
- [ ] Distinguish personal observation from generalizable guidance
- [ ] Maintained self-contained stages, links, and dependent local summaries
- [ ] `python3 validate.py .` passed (or explain why it failed)
- [ ] `python3 test_validate.py` passed (or explain why it failed)
- [ ] No third-party copyrighted binaries or personal records included
